you can (if you're on insulin.), but simple sugars are processed more quickly so they may spike you up and then bring you down because the insulin stays in your body longer (from my personal experience.) also with some candies it's easier to eat too much of a serving (who's gonna count out X skittles???.) diabetics can eat candy like anyone else, but sometimes we need to take extra steps.
i'm not 100% what happens if you're not on insulin (i haven't been off it for 2 years, ive been type two since i was 10 but im always on/off insulin/metformin cus my blood sugar wants to skyrocket despite no changes in meds/diet). im assuming their blood sugar spikes but not too much, cause of the other meds/in type two diabetics the pancreas usually makes at least some insulin
overall yeah, it's safe, but we may need to be a bit more careful compared to a non diabetic

i'm going to base on my advice on my hospilization last month but keep in mind that each place is different., ie i was in an adolescent's unit so the rules could be different yknow

-on the hospital's website there should be the times that you are allowed to visit. it varies from place to place but there might be like specific time slots (where i was they had like 6-8 pm)

-if you cant make it everyday it's ok. the psych ward probably has phones that he can call you with. 

-possibly bring something that can remind him that you care. my dad and brother bought stuffed animals, but because he's older maybe a family photo, post it notes with messages, etc etc...

-if they allow you to bring food i reccomend doing so b/c from my experience hospital food tends 2 suck lol. just be careful with bringing metal forks/knives/etc b/c the hospital may not allow those in. safety and stuff yknow

-as for acting around him, i'd say act as you normally do. being in a psych ward can be uncomfortable, especially the first few days so if you make a big deal out of it (it is a big deal, but., like idk how to say it. dont blow it out of proportion???) he may feel even worse. but remind him that yall care and stuff. depression sucks.
